mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, it is 35 degrees and partly cloudy at the Verona Public Library under a waning gibbous moon. We also have a great view of the ISS tonight; it will be visible for six minutes starting at 5:03 PM as it travels from the area near Verona High School toward Fitchburg, reaching about halfway up the sky.

In city news, candidate information packets are now available for the 2027 spring election. All four aldermanic districts are on the ballot, and you must file your paperwork with the City Clerk by 5:00 PM on January 5, 2027.

There is plenty to do in Verona, including the Crafty Fair today at ART House 360 and live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's tonight. Looking ahead, you can catch more music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
In our weekly report, on November 6, officers were dispatched to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a driver unconscious in a vehicle; she was subsequently arrested for O W I.
You can grab the Mint Cookie flavor of the day at Culver's, which opens today at 10:00 AM and closes at 10:30 PM.
